rule.title: Bike checkout limit
rule.purpose: Keep shared bikes circulating so that other members can find an available bike when they need one.
rule.text: A member may keep a bike for at most 24 consecutive hours. Returning the bike to any dock ends the checkout and resets the timer.

scenarios.text: A member docks a bike for ten seconds every 23 hours, immediately checks the same bike out again, and keeps it parked outside their home for a whole month.
A member's checkout reaches 25 hours because the city closed the only nearby dock during a power outage, and the member returns the bike the moment the dock reopens.
A member takes a bike on Monday and never returns it, riding it every day for three weeks without once visiting a dock.
A member rides a bike to the library, returns it to the dock after two hours, and a different member takes it a few minutes later.

duplicate_of_loophole: A member docks a bike for ten seconds every 23 hours, immediately checks the same bike out again, and keeps it parked outside their home for a whole year.

good.text: A member may keep a bike for at most 24 consecutive hours. Returning the bike to a dock ends the checkout, but checking the same bike out again within one hour of returning it continues the same checkout and the timer does not reset.

bad.text: A member may keep a bike for at most one hour. Returning the bike to any dock ends the checkout.
